report: 图像右上角存在明显的像素块状结构，这是JPEG压缩的典型特征。JPEG压缩专家的测量结果显示图像经过了JPEG压缩处理，且图像整体未发现明显的伪造痕迹。综合考虑，图像的真实性较高。然而，由于没有直接的伪造痕迹证据，且JPEG压缩专家的测量结果虽然支持图像经过了JPEG压缩，但其强度较低，不足以排除图像被伪造的可能性。因此，现有工具无法进一步降低不确定性。

evidence.phenomenon: JPEG structural analysis reveals DCT coefficient histogram hollowing. (blockiness: 1.0638, DCT anomaly: 4.3918)
evidence.reasoning: Moderate JPEG structure found (blockiness=1.0638, DCT anomaly=4.3918). This is the weaker end of the calibration band: the same structure appears when an already-compressed image is re-saved, and at low quality (≤ 70) the band loses its discriminative power almost entirely, so it should not drive a verdict on its own. Whether the band is decisive here depends on the cell the calibration table records for this input, which is attached to the token.
evidence.interpretation_text: Calibration: this measurement band corresponds to camera-source statistics (P(Fake)=0.39); the benign reading applies.
evidence.counter_explanation: 本指标衡量"是否存在 JPEG 压缩历史"而非伪造痕迹：G2 校准显示高值倾向 Real（PNG 格分离度 0.972、native 0.962，但重压缩至 q70 后降至 0.569），即它主要反映来源的压缩历史。统一重压缩后的图像上该证据近乎无效，不得作为独立判据。
evidence.applicability_conditions: 高 strength 统计上对应 Real（原生 JPEG 照片）；q70 配平后分离度仅 0.57。仅当来源无压缩历史时可反向参考。
evidence.interpretation_text_raw: Intermediate JPEG structural level; this band is near the calibrated chance level, and re-compression weakens it further.
